page.layout: One printed page, left part only (the right part is cut off). Top: a page title in large type and a line beginning "Questi ch..." set in italic-capital display. Then the main column of short italic entries, each group introduced by a bracket-rule, with line numbers 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 in the left margin beside the entries; a second heading "Questi ch..." in the middle, a further group, another "Questi cho..." heading and a last group. All text lies in one column, left portion of the page.; One printed page, cut at the left: running head at top with page number at top right; below, a series of heraldic family lists in two columns under braced headings (Italian), with a catchword and signature at the foot.
